subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: Fifth graders read history, science, and technical texts at their grade level and understand them, using all their skills: main ideas and details, vocabulary, structure, and evidence. Strong readers make inferences, use text features, and reread challenging sections.

items.prompt:
Read.

The Industrial Revolution changed how goods were made. Instead of making items by hand at home, people worked in factories with machines, which produced goods faster and cheaper.

What is the main idea?

steps: I ask what the whole passage is about.
It explains how the Industrial Revolution moved work from homes to factories.
So the main idea is that the Industrial Revolution changed production to factories and machines.
solution.answer: The Industrial Revolution changed how goods were made (to factories and machines).

items.prompt:
Read (same passage).

Why did factories produce goods faster?

steps: I find the reason in the text.
So factories were faster because they used machines.

items.prompt:
Read.

Coral reefs are built by tiny animals called polyps over thousands of years. Today, warming oceans threaten many reefs.

What can you infer about protecting reefs?

steps: Reefs take thousands of years to build but are threatened quickly.
So I infer that once damaged, reefs are hard to replace, making protection important.
solution.answer: Reefs are hard to replace, so protecting them matters.
